details:
- CVE-2026-53784: resolve the daemon module-root chdir through a trusted-owner
  walk so a planted symlink on the module path or any parent component cannot
  steer the daemon outside the module under "use chroot = no"
- CVE-2026-53795: confine each side of do_rename_at()/do_link_at()
  independently; an absolute --temp-dir or --link-dest previously disabled
  confinement for the relative in-tree side as well
- CVE-2026-53802: resolve operator-supplied input files (--filter merge files,
  --files-from, --password-file, daemon secrets) through the trusted-owner walk
  so a planted symlink cannot be read as filter rules or as the auth response
- CVE-2026-53803: resolve operator-supplied output paths (--log-file,
  --write-batch/--read-batch, daemon motd/lock/early-input/--config) through
  the same walk, plus a regular-file-or-FIFO check on the --read-batch file
